Our Story

A hook, some wool, and a lot of patience

I grew up watching my mother create beautiful things with her hands. She has always loved crochet, and over time, her handmade work became something our family truly cherished.

She started making beautiful poshak for Laddu Gopal for our own home mandir. Friends, neighbours and relatives began noticing her work and asking if she could make one for them too. That little beginning slowly turned into what is now The WarmStitch — from Pugal, one order at a time.

Every piece is handmade by my mother with patience, love and attention to detail. Each poshak is carefully checked and packed with the same care we would want for our own Thakur Ji.

Nothing here is mass-made. Every piece carries the warmth of handmade love.

  • 100% handcrafted, no machine work
  • Made-to-size Laddu Gopal poshak
  • Custom colours on request
  • Direct from maker, no middlemen
  • Local delivery across Bikaner
